integrity: Complete analytic proof and finite independent-algorithm checks; universal result is not extrapolated from finite verification. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary Mycielskians of odd cycles n>=5, not iterated constructions, arbitrary base graphs, weighted bipartization or alternative exchange operations. Literature searches and primary-text inspections do not prove global novelty; unindexed or differently termed vertex-bipartization studies remain a risk.
title: Optimal odd-cycle transversals of Mycielskian odd cycles and their exchange graphs
